H5800.def: a primitive root; to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.:--commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, × surely.

H5801.et: from (05800) in the sense of letting go (for a price, i.e. selling)
H5801.def: from «05800» in the sense of letting go (for a price, i.e. selling); trade, i.e. the place (mart) or the payment (revenue):--fair, ware.

H5802.def: from «05794» and the root of «0950»; stern depopulator; Azbuk, an Israelite:--Azbuk.

H5803.def: from «05794» and «01409»; stern troop; Azgad, an Israelite:--Azgad.

H5804.def: feminine of «05794»; strong; Azzah, a place in Palestine:--Azzah, Gaza.

H5805.def: feminine passive participle of «05800»; desertion (of inhabitants):--forsaking.

H5806.def: the same as «05805»; Azubah, the name of two Israelitesses:--Azubah.

H5808.def: from «05810»; forcible; collectively and concretely, an army:--power, strong.

H5809.def: or mAzzur {az-zoor'}; from «05826»; helpful; Azzur, the name of three Israelites:--Azur, Azzur.

H5810.def: a primitive root; to be stout (literally or figuratively):--harden, impudent, prevail, strengthen (self), be strong.

H5812.def: from «05810» and «03050»; Jah has strengthened; Azazjah, the name of three Israelites:--Azaziah.

H5813.def: from «05810»; forceful; Uzzi, the name of six Israelites:--Uzzi.

H5815.def: from «05756» and «0410»; strengthened of God; Aziel, an Israelite:--Aziel. Compare «03268».

H5816.def: from «05797» and «0410»; strength of God; Uzziel, the name of six Israelites:--Uzziel.

H5817.def: patronymically from «05816»; an Uzzielite (collectively) or descendants of Uzziel:--Uzzielites.

H5818.def: or Uzziyahuw {ooz-zee-yaw'-hoo}; from «05797» and «03050»; strength of Jah; Uzzijah, the name of five Israelites:--Uzziah.

H5820.def: from «05794» and «04194»; strong one of death; Azmaveth, the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine:--Azmaveth. See also «01041».

H5821.def: from «05794»; strong one; Azzan, an Israelite:--Azzan.

H5822.def: probably feminine of «05797»; probably the sea-eagle (from its strength):--ospray.

H5823.def: a primitive root; to grub over:--fence about.

H5824.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «05823»; a signet-ring (as engraved):--signet.

H5825.def: from «05823»; tilled; Azekah, a place in Palestine:--Azekah.

H5826.def: a primitive root; to surround, i.e. protect or aid:--help, succour.

H5827.def: from «05826»; help; Ezer, the name of two Israelites:--Ezer. Compare «05829».

H5829.def: the same as «05828»; Ezer, the name of four Israelites:--Ezer. Compare «05827».

H5830.def: a variation of «05833»; Ezra, an Israelite:--Ezra.

H5832.def: from «05826» and «0410»; God has helped; Azarel, the name of five Israelites:--Azarael, Azareel.

H5834.def: the same as «05833»; Ezrah, an Israelite:--Ezrah.

H5835.et: from (05826) in its original meaning of surrounding
H5835.def: from «05826» in its original meaning of surrounding; an inclosure; also a border:--court, settle.

H5837.def: from «05828» and «0410»; help of God; Azriel, the name of three Israelites:--Azriel.

H5838.def: or mAzaryahuw {az-ar-yaw'-hoo}; from «05826» and «03050»; Jah has helped; Azarjah, the name of nineteen Israelites:--Azariah.

H5839.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05838»; Azarjah, one of Daniel's companions:--Azariah.

H5840.def: from «05828» and active participle of «06965»; help of an enemy; Azrikam, the name of four Israelites:--Azrikam.

H5841.def: patrial from «05804»; an Azzathite or inhabitant of Azzah:--Gazathite, Gazite.

H5842.et: from (05860) (contracted) in the sense of swooping, i.e. side-long stroke
H5842.def: from «05860» (contracted) in the sense of swooping, i.e. side-long stroke; a stylus or marking stick:--pen.

H5844.def: a primitive root; to wrap, i.e. cover, veil, cloth, or roll:--array self, be clad, (put a) cover (-ing, self), fill, put on, × surely, turn aside.

H5845.et: from an unused root meaning apparently to contain
H5845.def: from an unused root meaning apparently to contain; a receptacle (for milk, i.e. pail; figuratively, breast):--breast.

H5846.et: from an unused root meaning to sneeze
H5846.def: from an unused root meaning to sneeze; sneezing:--sneezing.

H5848.def: a primitive root; to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflex.); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish:-- cover (over), fail, faint, feebler, hide self, be overwhelmed, swoon.

H5849.def: a primitive root; to encircle (for attack or protection); especially to crown (literally or figuratively):--compass, crown.

H5851.def: the same as «05850»; Atarah, an Israelitess:--Atarah.

H5852.def: or Ataroth {at-aw-roth'}; plural of «05850»; Ataroth, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine:--Ataroth.

H5853.def: from the same as «05852» and «0146»; crowns of Addar; Atroth-Addar, a place in Palestine: --Ataroth-adar(-addar).

H5854.et: from the same as (05852) and (01004) and (03097)
H5854.def: from the same as «05852» and «01004» and «03097»; crowns of the house of Joab; Atroth-beth-Joab, a place in Palestine:--Ataroth the house of Joab.

H5855.et: from the same as (05852) and a name otherwise unused [being from the same as (08226)] meaning hidden
H5855.def: from the same as «05852» and a name otherwise unused (being from the same as «08226») meaning hidden; crowns of Shophan; Atroth-Shophan, a place in Palestine:--Atroth, Shophan (as if two places).

H5857.def: or (feminine) uAya( (Neh. 11:31) {ah-yaw'}; or eAyath (Isaiah 10:28) {ah-yawth'}; for «05856»; Ai, Aja or Ajath, a place in Palestine:--Ai, Aija, Aijath, Hai.

H5858.et: perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be bald
H5858.def: perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be bald; bare; Ebal, a mountain of Palestine:--Ebal.

H5859.def: from «05856»; ruin; Ijon, a place in Palestine:--Ijon.

H5860.def: a primitive root; to swoop down upon (literally or figuratively):--fly, rail.

H5861.def: from «05860»; a hawk or other bird of prey:--bird, fowl, ravenous (bird).

H5862.def: from «05861»; hawk-ground; Etam, a place in Palestine:--Etam.

H5863.et: from the pl. of (05856) and the pl. of the act. part.of (05674) with the article interposed
H5863.def: from the plural of «05856» and the plural of the active participle of «05674» with the article interposed; ruins of the passers; Ije-ha-Abarim, a place near Palestine:--Ije-abarim.

H5864.def: plural of «05856»; ruins; Ijim, a place in the Desert.:--Iim.

H5867.def: or mOwlam (Ezra 10:2; Jeremiah 49:36) {o-lawm'}; probably from «05956»; hidden, i.e. distant; Elam, a son of Shem and his descendants, with their country; also of six Israelites:--Elam.

H5868.def: of doubtful origin and authenticity; probably meaning strength:--mighty.

H5869.def: probably a primitive word; an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape):--affliction, outward appearance, + before, + think best, colour, conceit, + be content, countenance, + displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, + favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), × him, + humble, knowledge, look, (+ well), × me, open(-ly), + (not) please, presence, + regard, resemblance, sight, × thee, × them, + think, × us, well, × you(-rselves).

H5871.def: the same as «05869»; fountain; Ajin, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine:--Ain.

H5872.def: from «05869» and «01423»; fountain of a kid; En-Gedi, a place in Palestine:--En-gedi.

H5873.def: from «05869» and the plural of «01588»; fountain of gardens; En-Gannim, a place in Palestine:--En-gannim.

H5874.def: or mEyn Dowr {ane dore}; or Eyn-Dor {ane-dore'}; from 5869 and «01755»; fountain of dwelling; En-Dor, a place in Palestine:--En-dor.

H5875.et: from (05869) and the act part of (07121)
H5875.def: from «05869» and the active participle of «07121»; fountain of One calling; En-hak-Kore, a place near Palestine:--En-hakhore.

H5876.et: from (05869) and the fem. of a derivative from (02300)
H5876.def: from «05869» and the feminine of a derivative from «02300»; fountain of sharpness; En-Chaddah, a place in Palestine:--En-haddah.

H5877.def: from «05869» and the same as «02674»; fountain of a village; En-Chatsor, a place in Palestine:--En-hazor.

H5878.def: from «05869» and a derivative of «02729»; fountain of trembling; En-Charod, a place in Palestine:--well of Harod.

H5879.def: or mEynam {ay-nawm'}; dual of «05869»; double fountain; Enajim or Enam, a place in Palestine:--Enaim, openly (Genesis 38:21).

H5880.def: from «05869» and «04941»; fountain of judgment; En-Mishpat, a place near Palestine:--En-mishpat.

H5881.def: from «05869»; having eyes; Enan, an Israelite:--Enan. Compare «02704».

H5882.def: «05869» and the dual of «05695»; fountain of two calves; En-Eglajim, a place in Palestine:--En-eglaim.

H5883.et: from (05869) and the act. part. of (07270)
H5883.def: from «05869» and the active participle of «07270»; fountain of a traveller; En-Rogel, a place near Jerusalem: --En-rogel.

H5884.def: from «05869» and «07416»; fountain of a pomegranate; En-Rimmon, a place in Palestine:--En-rimmon.

H5885.def: from «05869» and «08121»; fountain of the sun; En-Shemesh, a place in Palestine:--En-shemesh.

H5886.def: from «05869» and the plural of «08565»; fountain of jackals; En-Tannim, a pool near Jerusalem:--dragon well.

H5887.def: from «05869» and «08598»; fountain of an apple-tree; En-Tappuach, a place in Palestine:--En-tappuah.

H5888.def: a primitive root; to languish:--be wearied.

H5890.def: feminine from «05774»; obscurity (as if from covering):--darkness.

H5891.def: the same as «05890»; Ephah, the name of a son of Midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an Israelite and of an Israelitess:--Ephah.

H5892.et: from (05782) a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H5892.def: or (in the plural) par {awr}; or ayar (Judges 10:4) {aw-yar'}; from «05782» a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post):--Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.

H5893.def: the same as «05892»; Ir, an Israelite:--Ir.

H5894.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «05782»; a watcher, i.e. an angel (as guardian):--watcher.

H5895.et: from (05782) in the sense of raising (ie bearing a burden)
H5895.def: from «05782» in the sense of raising (i.e. bearing a burden); properly, a young ass (as just broken to a load); hence an ass-colt:--(ass) colt, foal, young ass.

H5896.def: from «05782»; wakefulness; Ira, the name of three Israelites:--Ira.

H5897.def: from the same as «06166»; fugitive; Irad, an antediluvian:--Irad.

H5898.et: from (05892) and (04417) with the article of substance interp
H5898.def: from «05892» and «04417» with the article of substance interp.; city of (the) salt; Ir-ham-Melach, a place near Palestine:--the city of salt.

H5899.et: from (05892) and the pl. of (08558) with the article interpolated
H5899.def: from «05892» and the plural of «08558» with the article interpolated; city of the palmtrees; Ir-hat-Temarim, a place in Palestine:--the city of palmtrees.
